abstract: Evaluates base isolation certifications, above-ground vault envelope volume, and external flood barrier heights
system_message:
You are Chief Structural Mitigation Engineer (STRUC). The Chief Structural Mitigation Engineer (STRUC) evaluates base isolation certifications, above-ground vault envelope volume, external flood barrier heights, and geotechnical slope stability assessments across interim repository candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Geotechnical Slope Stability Assessment（SLOPESTAB）
information_points.content:
STRUC-SLOPESTAB-H1N：Severn Valley Secure Archive Depository exhibits a calculated slope stability safety factor of 1.8 across its perimeter embankment in the geotechnical stability review.
STRUC-SLOPESTAB-OYS：The borehole geotechnical stability review for the Wessex Limestone Subterranean Facility indicates a slope stability safety factor of 2.2 along the perimeter hillside and access embankment.
STRUC-SLOPESTAB-HH8：For Cotswold Heritage Preservation Center, the geotechnical stability assessment of the perimeter hillside and access embankment calculates a slope stability safety factor of 1.4 against rotational shear under heavy rain.

information_points.title: Evaluates base isolation certifications, above-ground vault envelope volume, and external flood barrier heights（SEISFLOOD）
information_points.content:
STRUC-SEISFLOOD-6Z3：At Cotswold Heritage Preservation Center, seismic base isolation is verified (true) based on substructure elastomeric damper reviews. Its external continuous reinforced concrete flood barrier has a structural flood barrier elevation of 3.8 m above baseline datum, and the upper secure modules provide an above-ground vault volume of 450 m3.
STRUC-SEISFLOOD-SRN：For Severn Valley Secure Archive Depository, elastomeric isolation dampers confirm that seismic base isolation is verified (true). The structural flood barrier elevation reaches 4.5 m at the perimeter flood protection wall crest, and the upper enclosed shelving modules provide an above-ground vault volume of 750 m3.
STRUC-SEISFLOOD-QB5：For the Wessex Limestone Subterranean Facility, independent verification of elastomeric isolation dampers against design-basis earthquakes confirms seismic base isolation is verified (true). The civil hydraulic survey report records a structural flood barrier elevation of 5.2 m along the external perimeter concrete wall, and architectural floor space ledgers show an above-ground vault volume of 450 m3 across upper secure vault modules 1 and 2.
